description:
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Glasspool Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Glasspool Mimic enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Glasspool Mimics into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Glasspool Mimic tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
